description: Force Steam Datagram Relay traffic onto the Tokyo POP by blocking every other relay, so matchmaking cannot hand you a distant relay while a ~20ms one is available. Recipe from https://zenn.dev/kikurage7/articles/8b4d12fe0b7198 . Game-agnostic: appId is derived from the -Program executable via Steam's appmanifest, so point -Program at any game's .exe. Replace "auto" with a numeric appId if you want to apply this machine-wide instead.

rules.description: Current-generation SDR relays outside the tyo POP. Address list and port range are both read from Valve's published config at apply time, so re-running this tracks their infrastructure changes.

Previous-generation P2P relays on UDP 4379-4380. These are not listed by GetSDRConfig, so Valve's netblocks are hard-coded here. Tokyo's legacy range 45.121.184.0/24 is deliberately absent from the list, which is how the Tokyo legacy relays stay reachable.
